description: Hand a setup job to OBZDN on behalf of the person you represent. Only call this when they asked for it AND agreed to share these contact details with OBZDN. Returns the booking link for them to pick a 20-minute call. OBZDN never asks for passwords; access is granted by the owner on the call.

assistant_name.description: Which assistant is making this request, e.g. 'Grok', 'ChatGPT', 'Claude'

details.description: Anything useful: current tools, deadline, budget

human_approved.description: Must be true: the person agreed to share these details with OBZDN for this request

wants.description: Tool id or service id, or plain words, e.g. 'set up Jobber AI Receptionist'

name: request_setup
title: Ask OBZDN to do the setup
